QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Evan's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Evan to get the message.
QuestInfo.1: Evan's message is for his #bparents#k! #bGo to the Hill North of Henesys, take the middle of the three portals on the right, then move in further#k to get to his parents's farm.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Evan's message to #bhis parents#k, who were clearly more and more proud of their son with every word he spoke.

default.0: My house is hard to find, isn't it?\r\nJust go to the Hill North of Henesys, take the middle portal of the three on the right, then keep on going right. \r\n
